title: Cinelli Road Range 2023 - Pressure
notes: Dated official catalog establishes the first-generation Pressure as a distinct T800 high-modulus carbon aero frame with proprietary lay-up, 990 g claimed frame, 390 g claimed fork, Press Fit 86.5 bottom bracket, 30 mm maximum clearance and several factory build families. The current Pressure 2 is a later generation and is kept separate.
